Specification: This specification models a single-variable counter system in which the variable x is initialized to 1 and can increment by 1 while it remains less than 5. The temporal specification combines the initial condition with a boxed next-state relation, an explicit weak fairness condition WF_x(Next), and several temporal formulas including a nested liveness/fairness-style implication, a negated eventuality, and a safety-style box asserting x < 3. It also defines an invariant x < 4, a separate temporal property constraining the next-state value of x to the set {1, 2}, and states a theorem that Spec implies []Invariant.
